data.dataset_note: Read-only for users. Throughput is shared by the whole cluster (~100 MiB/s).
data.dataset_use: shared, read-only reference data in /data/shared: `module load <module>` sets the variables listed under env; do not copy it into home or scratch
data.how_to_load: module load <name>[/<version>]; MPI-built packages appear after `module load openmpi` (or mpich / intel-oneapi-mpi). Compilers: gcc/13.5.0 is the default toolchain of the Spack stack. `module spider <name>` shows how to reach any module.
